syntactic_simplification: Mice are important in neuroscience research. They provide a model that scientists can control and study. This helps scientists learn about how the brain works. Researchers have often used male mice in experiments. They do this partly because female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can cause changes in behavior. Such changes might affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in studying the brain. They give scientists a way to control and examine mice. This helps scientists understand how the brain works. Researchers often use male mice in their tests. They do this partly because female mice have hormone changes. These changes can alter their behavior. Such changes might affect the findings of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important for studying the brain. They provide scientists with a way to control and look closely at them. This helps scientists understand how the brain functions. Researchers often use male mice in their experiments, which are tests to learn more about something. They do this partly because female mice have hormone changes. Hormones are natural substances in the body that can affect how animals feel or act. These changes can alter the way female mice behave, and that might influence the results of the tests.

source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important for studying the brain. They help scientists learn more about how the brain works. Researchers often use male mice in their experiments. They do this partly because female mice have hormone changes. Hormones are natural substances in the body that can change how animals feel or act. These changes can affect how female mice behave and might influence the results of the experiments.
